card.name: Early words in numbered label sections
card.fires_on: Common words or punctuation shortly after a numbered subsection heading such as 10.1 Human Overdose Experience or 2.1 Recommended Dosage. Also fires on a few partway-through-word spots in drug label text.

modes.label: After overdose heading
modes.description: Linking word or punctuation in the first sentences under the 10.1 overdose experience heading.
modes.example: 10.1 Human Overdose Experience Isolated cases<< of>> overdose with oxcarbazepine tablets

modes.label: Dosage or interaction subsection
modes.description: Comma or bracket in the opening sentence of a numbered dosage or drug-interaction subsection.
modes.example: Apply one drop to the affected eye once daily beginning 1 day prior to cataract surgery<<,>> continued on the day of surgery, and

modes.label: Inside medical terms
modes.description: Partway through a long drug or condition name in label text.
modes.example: • Primary treatment of status asthmatic<<us>> or acute episodes of COPD or asthma
